messages:
maria_ops: noticing multiple customer reports of 5xx + p99/p999 tail latency on hosted inference since ~08:12 UTC. looks like request queue depth climbs and continuous-batcher backlog never drains. filing for escalation, tagging SRE. grafana: https://graf.redwood/g/ingress/queue-depth?snapshot=latest :exclamation:

jordan_sre: can you paste the exact error pattern? is it 502/504 or timeouts from batcher? also any tenant correlation?

maria_ops: primarily 504 gateway timeouts and some 502s. customer acme-pay seeing spikes from ~08:10->08:28. tenant id: tenant-acmepay-42. grok of logs shows dequeue timeouts and 'batcher_queue_timeout' metric firing.

ken_support: acme-pay cs here — they report many small chat requests (avg tokens 12) suddenly ramping from 20r/s -> 250r/s for ~10m. they retried a few times which may have amplified. they want a repro timeline and ETA.

elaine_prod_eng: we rolled a batcher config tweak at 07:50 that reduced batch max_wait_ms from 50 -> 30 to lower latency; suspect this made the scheduler more aggressive and pushed more micro-batches to queueing. might have exposed queue depth limit bug when combined with prefix KV warmups. reverting in-flight patch as default mitigation.

jordan_sre: quick checks: 
```
# check queue depths
kubectl -n inference exec pod/batcher-0 -- curl -s localhost:9090/metrics | grep request_queue_depth
request_queue_depth 235
```
Also looking at continuous-batcher backlog metric: `continuous_batch_backlog{zone="us-east-1"} 180`

maria_ops: running rollback now per Elaine: `deployctl rollback batcher-config-2026-07-14`

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback initiated by maria_ops for batcher-config-2026-07-14 (id: dc-rollback-739). started at 08:23 UTC.

jordan_sre: while rollback runs, throttle ingress for tenant-acmepay-42 to prevent requeue storms: `rate-limiter set tenant-acmepay-42 50r/s`

maria_ops: applied tenant throttle, confirmed `ratelimit: tenant-acmepay-42 -> 50r/s`

elaine_prod_eng: rollback finished at 08:27, batcher max_wait_ms back to 50. watching queue depth. advise to keep tenant throttle for 30m and engage customer to avoid retries.

jordan_sre: metrics update at 08:30: request_queue_depth dropped from 235 -> 18, continuous_batch_backlog -> 2, p99 tail latency normalized.

acme-pay-cs: thanks team. I'll notify engineering contact and ask them to stop client-side aggressive retries. they want a short postmortem and whether this will recur.

maria_ops: next actions: 1) SRE to add guardrail that prevents batcher max_wait_ms < 40 in production when prefix-warmup flag enabled. 2) Support to coordinate with acme-pay to remove retry storm. 3) Prod eng to add a circuit-breaker when queue_depth > 200 for any single tenant.

jordan_sre: ACK; creating follow-up ticket INF-7862 for queue-depth circuit-breaker + runbook update.

elaine_prod_eng: also adding telemetry event to flag config changes that reduce batch wait below safety threshold. will PR today.

maria_ops: marking incident as mitigated at 08:31 UTC. will keep channel open for any regression. :white_check_mark:
